prompt_meta.title: Remediate STEP-0019: Scope Compliance + Hard Proof + Merge to main + Guardrails (No new UI modules)

allowed_changes: Remove/revert any unintended API changes from STEP-0019 unless absolutely required for Auth/Onboarding correctness
If API changes are required, they must be minimal, documented, and fully tested
Improve proof assets (screenshots, logs) for Auth/Onboarding only
Add guardrails to prevent future scope violations (scripts/docs/CI checks)
disallowed_changes: Any redesign or new UI work beyond Auth/Onboarding (already done in STEP-0019)
Any changes to Games/Clubs/Venues/Chat/Notifications/Profile UI (except compile fix if broken)

step_objectives.goal: Make STEP-0019 truly shippable: correct branch strategy, remove scope creep, add proof evidence, run full gates, and ensure main is green.
outcomes: STEP-0019 work is on main (merge or fast-forward) with clear commit hash
No unintended API changes remain (or minimal justified fixes only)
Full root gates executed with evidence: integrity + lint + test + build
Hard proof assets exist for premium Auth/Onboarding UX (screenshots include loading/error/resume)
Guardrails added so IDE cannot silently violate scope/branch rules again
definition_of_done: Any unintended API edits are reverted OR justified + tested
pnpm -r integrity/lint/test/build all pass with captured command outputs
Push to origin/main completed and reported

must_capture: At least 14 Android screenshots for Auth/Onboarding including: login, signup, validation error, network error, loading state, onboarding steps 1-5, resume after restart, success
At least 1 screenshot/video-proof showing the emulator running (AVD name visible via emulator UI or a captured command output + screenshot pairing)
Logs of the exact commands used to boot emulator and launch app (stdout_tail in report)
evidence_requirements.storage_rule: All assets saved under reports/assets/STEP-0020/ and referenced in report.

required: A scope-guard mechanism that fails CI (or fails a local check) if files outside allowed scope are modified for a step prompt
A branch rule guard: step prompts must end with code on main (merge or direct push) and report must include main commit hash
Update ops/PROTOCOL.md with these rules and enforcement approach

tasks.name: Repo/Branch remediation
tasks.objective: Move STEP-0019 changes onto main properly (merge PR or merge branch locally) and ensure origin/main is updated.
acceptance: report includes main commit hash and push evidence

tasks.name: Scope creep removal
tasks.objective: Identify why apps/api files changed in STEP-0019; revert them unless strictly required for Auth/Onboarding correctness. If required, document and add/adjust tests.
acceptance: Either API changes are reverted OR justified + tested
report lists exactly what remained and why

tasks.name: Hard proof capture for Auth/Onboarding
tasks.objective: Re-run emulator flows and capture the required screenshots (loading/error/resume included).

tasks.name: Run full root gates with evidence
tasks.objective: Run pnpm -r integrity, lint, test, build (no skipping) and capture outputs in report.
acceptance: commands_run includes exit codes and stdout/stderr tails

tasks.name: Add guardrails
tasks.objective: Add CI/local checks so future steps cannot (a) push to wrong branch, (b) modify out-of-scope modules without failing, (c) claim completion without gates/evidence.

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. This is remediation only: fix branch/main, remove scope creep, capture hard proof for Auth/Onboarding, run full root gates with evidence, add guardrails, push to origin/main, update ops/manifest.json, and write a complete reports/STEP-0020.report.json with no placeholders. Do not ask the owner to run commands.
